source_semantic_controls: Published V1 examples August 10 to October 19 and July 7 to September 15 are correctly implemented, including maximum of 70 days and September 15. Selected enrolled versus known unenrolled parcels correctly bound the component band.

A known exclusively prior-year sowing with no current-year establishment is a source-derived temporal definition counterexample. Proper 2024 establishment technique does not stipulate renewed 2025 sowing. The expected exclusion concerns the source unit, not an invented sanction or contractual lapse.

Care mowing is not the expressly allowed early non-ground-level problem-weed chopping exception. The synthetic counter retains actual necessity and evidence; the paired chopping control is positive. No monetary reduction is inferred.

The V7 impairment restriction is checked against the actual cover period. A post-period local violation is not proof of an actual imposed sanction. Main-crop conversion is already ineligible; missing mandatory withdrawal advice is a separate procedural coverage finding.

The mechanical PSM helper omits variant and frost-only-component conditions actually stored and read by the separate mechanical-method validator. A method finding does not repair the missing local PSM diagnosis.

Insect lists are examples, not a complete universe. Single Mungo/Ramtillkraut/Schwarzsamen names are conditional interface controls; an explicit positive insect count is a correct alternative. The fictional externally approved rye token tests a representational limit, not a real newly approved variety.

The generic family count needs an explicit V1 counting domain for qualifying insect-pollinated partners. Extra grass families do not establish that condition. No unagreed source counterexample is invented from ambiguous input meaning.

The regional harvest-waiver helper covers geography, while actual drought, absence of harvestable stand and late-harvest crop scope remain external. Positive regional controls stipulate those conditions. Nationwide cover/volunteer-cereal relief is separate from the harvest district map.

Actual current 6/7 incompatibility, future contract/measure scope, earlier effective exit and later transfers are temporal eligibility components. They do not select which measure ultimately receives payment after an allowed correction. An ineffective withdrawal after inspection notice can leave the existing contract in force.

Correct public-body exception, provided park-restriction/public-overlap consumers, parcel ineligibility/payment blocks, assessed sanctions and weighted modulation are actual implemented improvements. Known properly_established=false expects only the source obligation finding, not an invented automatic zero premium.

Home-area versus total-area modulation is conditional on the caller denominator meaning. A band straddling 50 EUR supports a lower-endpoint warning, not known final waiver eligibility. The arbitrary final EGFL rate and full ordered reduction/authority chain remain external.

SRL versus newer leaflet rolling/removal interpretations and the August notice swapped deadlines remain disclosed source conflicts. The native use of the consistent actual variant dates is preserved; no unqualified frost-rolling defect or retroactive GSP formula is asserted.
